interface.title: BVID-FE — Barely Visible Impact Damage analysis
interface.field: Aerospace structures / composite materials damage tolerance
interface.stage_of_work: analysis and disposition (after an impact event or a non-destructive inspection, before Material Review Board review)
interface.what_it_is_for: Predict the compression- or tension-after-impact residual strength of a composite laminate panel from an impact event or a measured C-scan, at one of three model tiers, then view the damage, sweep energy and export results or a nonconformance report.

data.note: Most runs used the built-in preset 'Empirical quick (IM7/8552 quasi-iso, 20 J)' (IM7/8552, [0/45/-45/90/90/-45/45/0], 150×100 mm panel, 16 mm impactor). The inspection-driven run used the test file sample_cscan.json, which loaded 7 delaminations and a 0.38 mm dent. Files downloaded: bvidfe_results.json, bvidfe_sweep_semi_analytical.csv, NCR-20261029-001.md, NCR-20261029-001.json.

tree.general: Estimate how much strength a damaged composite panel keeps, and document a disposition for it
tree.specific: Predict CAI/TAI residual strength and knockdown for barely-visible impact damage on a laminate panel (only compression was run here), and export an NCR with a proposed MRB disposition

features.name: Tiered model fidelity selector
features.general: Pick a model fidelity, set its extra options if it has any, rerun, and compare headline metrics and notes across fidelities
features.specific: Tier dropdown (empirical / semi_analytical / fe3d) with a fe3d-only Mesh parameters expander (elements per ply, in-plane size); after Run analysis the Summary metrics and runtime notes reflect the chosen tier
steps: read pristine/residual/knockdown and the runtime notes
serves_tasks: Re-run with a more detailed model on the same specimen

features.name: Stale-results guard
features.general: Warn that the results on screen no longer match the current inputs, and clear the warning once you rerun
features.specific: Any sidebar change (e.g. Tier) shows 'Sidebar inputs changed since the last run — results are stale' until Run analysis is pressed
steps: see the banner clear and the results update
serves_tasks: Re-run with a more detailed model on the same specimen

features.name: Damage source switch with file-gated run
features.general: Choose between modelled and measured input; for measured input, upload a file, get a parse confirmation, and only then can you run
features.specific: Damage source radio (Impact event / C-scan inspection); C-scan mode swaps the energy inputs for a JSON uploader plus dent-depth and fiber-break fields, shows 'Loaded N delamination(s)', and enables Run analysis
serves_tasks: Supply measured damage instead of a modelled impact
Compute strength from measured inspection data

features.name: Live pre-run estimate banner
features.general: Show a cheap estimate of the outcome as inputs change, before the expensive run
features.specific: Blue banner with E_onset and predicted DPA (mm² and % of panel), recomputed when the preset or energy changes (3156 → 2074 mm² going from 30 J to 20 J)
steps: read the updated E_onset / DPA banner

features.name: Buckling indicator panel
features.general: Show the critical buckling load of the whole panel and of damaged sub-layers, so you can see which governs
features.specific: Buckling tab: bar chart and table of critical buckling load; the quantity and units change with the tier (N_cr in N/mm at semi_analytical; Rayleigh-Ritz lower of panel/sublaminate buckling at fe3d)
steps: run an analysis at a chosen tier
read the critical load and its units
serves_tasks: Check whether the panel or a damaged sub-layer buckles first

features.name: Automatic sensitivity curve around the current input
features.general: Without extra setup, run a cheap model over a fixed range around the current input and show the strength-loss curve with a table
features.specific: Knockdown Curve tab: empirical 7-point sweep from 0.2× to 2× the current impact energy, independent of the selected tier, with a data table; Impact event mode only
steps: run an analysis in Impact event mode
serves_tasks: View an automatic strength-loss curve around the current input

features.name: Parametric sweep with curve, table and CSV export
features.general: Enter a list of input values, choose the method, run them as a batch, and get a curve, a table and a CSV download
features.specific: Sweep tab: comma-separated energies, Tier for sweep, Run sweep → results table (knockdown, residual, DPA, dent, n_delaminations, error) + knockdown-vs-energy plot + Download sweep CSV
serves_tasks: Run a custom parameter sweep and export it

features.name: Interactive 3D damage mesh viewer
features.general: Inspect a 3D mesh coloured by a damage scalar: rotate, zoom, pan, hover for coordinates, reset the camera, save as PNG
features.specific: 3D Damage tab: Plotly mesh of 1 − damage_factor (out-of-plane stiffness loss) with a toolbar for Zoom / Pan / Orbital / Turntable rotation / Reset camera / PNG download
steps: drag to orbit (the mouse wheel zooms)

features.name: Layered damage footprint map
features.general: Draw each layer's damage outline over the specimen, coloured by layer, with the impact point marked, to see where damage overlaps
features.specific: Damage Map tab: delamination ellipses coloured by interface index, impact X marker, dent depth in the title
steps: read the ellipse outlines against the interface-index colourbar
serves_tasks: See the damage footprint per layer interface
Compute strength from measured inspection data

features.name: Through-thickness damage severity heatmap
features.general: Sum damage through the thickness onto a plan-view grid to show where it concentrates, labelled with the model and result
features.specific: Damage Severity tab: stacked out-of-plane loss grid titled with tier and knockdown
steps: read the summed intensity and the tier/KD title
serves_tasks: See where damage concentrates through the thickness

features.name: Downloadable full results record
features.general: Save the complete result of a run as a structured file for later use or audit
features.specific: Download results JSON button below the Summary (bvidfe_results.json)

features.name: Report form with rule-based recommendation and export

features.specific: Export NCR tab: NCR number, originator, part, found-during and type fields, plus the BVID detectability threshold → proposed MRB disposition path, flags (VID vs BVID, delamination count), a Preview NCR expander, and Download NCR (Markdown/JSON)

download it as Markdown or JSON
